title: Pembrolizumab for MSI-H/dMMR Metastatic Colorectal Cancer
brief_summary: Clinical trial 5 for Metastatic Colorectal Adenocarcinoma. This is a Phase 2 study.
detailed_description: This clinical trial evaluates the efficacy and safety of investigational therapy for Metastatic Colorectal Adenocarcinoma. Participants will be assessed for response, progression-free survival, and overall survival.
inclusion_criteria: Histologically confirmed mCRC with MSI-H or dMMR status; Any number of prior lines; ECOG PS 0-1; Measurable disease
exclusion_criteria: Prior PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitor; Active autoimmune disease; Organ transplant
eligibility_criteria: Histologically confirmed mCRC with MSI-H or dMMR status; Any number of prior lines; ECOG PS 0-1; Measurable disease. Exclusion: Prior PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitor; Active autoimmune disease; Organ transplant
